newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes lower on dollar gains.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes lower on dollar gains.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed down against the dollar on Tuesday as banks expected the dollar to consolidate on its overseas gains, brokers said.
The rupee closed at 58.74 to the U.S. currency after opening at 58.65. On Monday the rupee closed at 58.48.
"People were expecting the dollar to appreciate and sellers were very limited," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer. "Banks are carrying dollar plus positions, hoping the dollar to climb further."
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by 4.75 local cents, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.3506 and 59.5294.
Low call rates also fueled demand for dollars, dealers said.
Overnight call money closed at 9.5 percent after opening at 12 percent, dealers said.
